object.identity_scope_note: Atlantic Ocean westward South Equatorial Current under the NOAA glossary basin convention. The qualified label is editorial. Dimensions, layer bounds, current axis and annual envelopes require separate evidence. This is distinct from the existing cross-basin family, countercurrents, undercurrents and regional branches.

widths.boundary_rule: Zero crossings of signed cross-section velocity averaged over January 1993-December 2017; the half-peak strength domain is a separate operator.
widths.extraction_method: Transcribed author-reported numerical section widths and definition; no figure or velocity array digitized.
widths.geographic_scope: HS4 / nSEC4: source-specific regional branch or retroflection zone; not a uniform whole-current width.
widths.layer: Altimetry-derived surface geostrophic field; no fixed-depth bounds inferred.
widths.name: Atlantic South Equatorial Current
widths.range_interpretation: Published approximate mean-field oblique section width; no error interval. Regional sections do not establish annual or seasonal extrema.
remaining_gates: Independent scientific admission and native/WASM/UI delivery remain pending.
Recover source section endpoints and paired mean velocity edges before physical geometry or state intersections.
Annual extrema, numerical uncertainty and whole-current representativeness remain unknown.
widths.section_orientation: Source rotated section component: 315 degrees; exact endpoints and paired edge coordinates not extracted.

widths.source_locator: Printed Table 1, page 256 (called Table 2 in prose); Sections 2.1 and 3.
widths.source_quality_note: Author-reported approximate width of mean surface geostrophic section profile; 0.25-degree product omits ageostrophic flow. Unknown paired geometry, product release version and numerical uncertainty are retained.
widths.time_convention: January 1993–December 2017 mean velocity-profile context; width of mean field, not mean instantaneous width or seasonal range.
